hero.summary: Over four decades of foundational metallurgical research at IISc Bangalore and two decades of industrial leadership. Key contributor to India’s strategic defense and space missions—including Al-Li alloys for the Light Combat Aircraft (LCA Tejas), high-damping Naval propeller alloys, extreme deep-sea titanium corrosion studies at 5,100 meters, and 2,000+ space-grade hybrid microelectronic subsystems for ISRO's Chandrayaan missions.

about.section_title: From Eswarahalli: An Extraordinary Dynasty of Scholars
about.section_subtitle: Born on 22 May 1941 in Bangalore to Eswarahalli Rangachar Sundararajan and Eswarahalli Sundararajan Lokamata, tracing family roots to the tranquil hamlet of Eswarahalli in Hassan district, Karnataka.
about.heritage_title: A Historic Academic Feat in India
about.heritage_p1: Prof. E. S. Dwarakadasa is part of an unmatched intellectual legacy. He was raised as one of 14 siblings, including 9 younger brothers. In an unprecedented testament to educational dedication and parental vision, every single one of the 14 siblings graduated in Engineering.
about.heritage_p2: Even more remarkably, 7 of the brothers earned Ph.D. degrees in engineering and advanced sciences, and 8 of them are proud alumni of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore. This extraordinary family tradition of scholarship has produced professors, research directors, and engineering pioneers across the world.
about.heritage_quote: A rural family heritage transformed by relentless academic discipline into a legacy of national engineering excellence.

breakthroughs.title: Light Combat Aircraft (LCA Tejas) Alloys
breakthroughs.desc: Pioneered the development and thermomechanical characterization of lightweight Aluminium-Lithium (Al-Li 8090) alloys and 7050 aircraft alloy for India’s indigenous Light Combat Aircraft (LCA Tejas). Addressed critical stress corrosion cracking, fatigue crack thresholds, and lithium depletion kinetics.

breakthroughs.title: High-Damping Copper-Manganese Naval Propellers
breakthroughs.desc: Formulated and optimized high-damping Copper-Manganese (Cu-Mn) alloys specifically engineered for Indian Naval ship and submarine propeller applications. The alloy provides unmatched acoustic signature reduction, vibration absorption, and cavitation erosion resistance.

breakthroughs.title: Deep-Sea Ti-6Al-4V at 5,100 Meters
breakthroughs.desc: Conducted benchmark deep-sea exposure trials in the Indian Ocean down to depths of 5,100 meters under intense hydrostatic pressure, proving zero detectable corrosion in titanium Ti-6Al-4V alloys. Laid the scientific foundation for deep-sea submersibles and ocean mining structures.

breakthroughs.title: Industrial Failure Analysis & Forensics
breakthroughs.desc: Over 40 years as India's foremost independent consultant in forensic engineering and metallurgical failure diagnosis. Consulted on high-pressure steam pipelines, turbine rotor cracking, aerospace landing gears, and chemical reactor vessels.

industry.title: Pioneering Space & Defense Microelectronics
industry.subtitle: Karnataka Hybrid Micro Devices Limited (KHMD) • High-Reliability Electronics
industry.desc: As CEO and Managing Director of KHMD for over two decades, Prof. Dwarakadasa spearheaded the domestic development of space-qualified hybrid microelectronic circuits. Under his leadership, KHMD supplied over 2,000 mission-critical modules directly integrated into ISRO launch vehicles, Chandrayaan lunar payloads, and Indian defense avionics systems.
